## Iaculo (CR 1)

You just hear a faint hiss before a tiny, multicolored serpent plunges toward you from a branch above, its body rigid as an arrow, aiming for your throat.  

**XP** 400  
N Tiny animal  
**Init** +2; **Senses** low-light vision, scent; Perception +5  


**Defense**


**AC** 14, touch 14, flat-footed 12 (+2 Dex, +2 size)  
**hp** 18 (2d8+2)  
**Fort** +4, **Ref** +5, **Will** +1  


**Offense**


**Speed** 20 ft., climb 30 ft.  
**Melee** bite +5 (1d2-2)  
**Special Attacks** impaling dive +5 (1d6 plus impale)  


**Statistics**


**Str** 4, **Dex** 15, **Con** 13, **Int** 2, **Wis** 12, **Cha** 4  
**Base Atk** +1; **CMB** +3 (+7 with grapple); **CMD** 10 (can’t be tripped)  
**Feats** Weapon Finesse  
**Skills** Climb +20, Perception +5, Stealth +14; **Racial Modifiers** +4 Climb, +4 Stealth  


**Special Abilities**



**Familiar** The master of a iaculo familiar gains a +3 bonus on Climb checks.  

**Impaling Dive (Ex)** A iaculo can drop on a victim from a high place, stiffening its body like an arrow in a gore attack. If the attack hits, it deals 1d6 points of piercing damage and the iaculo stabs through its prey, leaving part of its body inside it and effectively impaling it. This functions as the attach universal monster ability. At the beginning of its turn, an impaling iaculo automatically deals another 1d6 points of damage and can also try to bite its victim. A target who manages to remove the iaculo from its body suffers the same damage as having it attached in a round.  


**Ecology**


**Environment** temperate forests  
**Organization** solitary or hail (1-20)  
**Treasure** none
